authorization: User selected age65plus healthy primary and all healthy secondary; previously proposed direct 3D deviation vs clinical scores before neural-network training.
question: In older stroke survivors, is greater 3D gait deviation from healthy reference associated with lower POMA?
cycle_alignment: Each limb uses its own ipsilateral initial-contact-to-initial-contact source segment. Healthy LsideSegm_LsideData and RsideSegm_RsideData; stroke PsideSegm_PsideData and NsideSegm_NsideData.
sign_convention: Use source Plug-in Gait anatomical signs. No data-dependent sign flips or phase shifts. Verify original lower-body angle output definition before scoring. Pool healthy sides only in their own-cycle anatomical convention.
quality_rule: Complete 9-variable strides: all 1001 original time samples finite for all nine variables. No imputation, clipping or outcome-dependent exclusion. At least one complete stride on each side required. Log every rejected stride and excluded person.
person_waveform: Arithmetic mean across accepted strides within each side; select 51 evenly spaced samples.
reference_waveform: Equal mean of the two side mean curves per healthy person, then equal mean across reference people. Both sides share this pooled reference.
score_formula: For each side, sqrt(mean((person_side_waveform-reference_waveform)^2)) over 9 variables and 51 time samples; person score is arithmetic mean of the two side scores.
normal_evaluation: Leave the complete person out of the relevant reference, including both sides and all strides. No person split into independent observations.
primary_endpoint: Spearman correlation of primary-reference bilateral score with POMA among stroke age65plus. Expected direction negative; no preset effect-size pass/fail threshold.
secondary_endpoints: Spearman with FAC and TIS in same older stroke people
Healthy leave-person-out and older stroke score distributions

uncertainty.method: Resample healthy reference persons and stroke persons independently with replacement; rebuild reference, recompute stroke scores, correlate paired stroke scores and labels; percentile 95% interval. Discard undefined constant-label replicates and report count.

interpretation: Exploratory association, not functional-score prediction accuracy, clinical diagnosis, original GDI validity, general elderly validity, or RGB-video validity. Secondary comparisons are descriptive; no multiplicity-adjusted confirmatory claims.
analysis_scope: No neural network, threshold fitting, calibration to 100, or model selection. Preserve negative and uncertain findings.
